generator_tools.name: generate_pydantic
generator_tools.description: Generate Pydantic BaseModel classes from the domain model. Produces validated data models with type hints and field validators. Output: pydantic_classes.py

backend.description: Generate 'Create' suffixed models for API request bodies

nested_creations.description: Allow nested entity creation in request bodies

generator_tools.name: generate_sqlalchemy
generator_tools.description: Generate SQLAlchemy ORM models from the domain model. Produces table definitions with relationships, foreign keys, and inheritance. Output: sql_alchemy.py

generator_tools.name: generate_fastapi_backend
generator_tools.description: Generate a complete, MODULAR FastAPI backend with CRUD endpoints, SQLAlchemy ORM, and Pydantic models. This is the most complete backend generator. Output: main_api.py (slim app) + database.py + routers/<Class>.py (endpoints per class) + sql_alchemy.py + pydantic_classes.py + bal_stdlib.py + requirements.txt

http_methods.description: HTTP methods to generate endpoints for

generator_tools.name: generate_django
generator_tools.description: Generate a full Django project with models, views, templates, URL routing, and admin panel. Output: full Django project directory

generator_tools.name: generate_python_classes
generator_tools.description: Generate plain Python classes with __init__, getters/setters, relationships. Output: classes.py

generator_tools.name: generate_java_classes
generator_tools.description: Generate Java classes from the domain model. Output: .java files zipped.

generator_tools.name: generate_sql
generator_tools.description: Generate raw SQL CREATE TABLE statements. Output: tables.sql

generator_tools.name: generate_json_schema
generator_tools.description: Generate JSON Schema from the domain model. Output: json_schema.json

generator_tools.name: generate_rest_api
generator_tools.description: Generate FastAPI REST endpoints + Pydantic models. Lighter than generate_fastapi_backend (no ORM). Output: rest_api.py + pydantic_classes.py

generator_tools.name: generate_react
generator_tools.description: Generate a React TypeScript frontend from the domain model + GUI model. REQUIRES a GUI model — fails without one. Output: full React app directory

generator_tools.name: generate_web_app
generator_tools.description: Generate a complete full-stack web app: React frontend + FastAPI backend + Docker deployment. REQUIRES a GUI model. Output: frontend/ + backend/ + docker-compose.yml

generator_tools.name: generate_rdf
generator_tools.description: Generate RDF/OWL vocabulary (Turtle format). Output: vocabulary.ttl

generator_tools.name: generate_qiskit
generator_tools.description: Generate a Qiskit Python script from the Quantum Circuit model. REQUIRES a quantum circuit. Output: qiskit_circuit.py

shots.description: Number of shots for the simulation (default: 1024)

generator_tools.name: generate_supabase
generator_tools.description: Generate Supabase-flavoured PostgreSQL DDL from the domain model — UUID primary keys, auth.users mirroring, and Row-Level-Security (RLS) policies. Output: a .sql file.

user_root.description: Class mapped to Supabase auth users (default: User)

generator_tools.name: generate_json_object
generator_tools.description: Generate a JSON document of the object (instance) model — the concrete instances and their attribute/relationship values (useful as seed data / fixtures). REQUIRES an object model. Output: <model>.json

generator_tools.name: generate_baf
generator_tools.description: Generate a BESSER Agent Framework (BAF) chatbot/agent project from the agent model. REQUIRES an agent model. Output: a Python BAF agent project.

generator_tools.name: generate_bpmn
generator_tools.description: Generate vendor-neutral BPMN 2.0 XML from the BPMN process model. REQUIRES a BPMN model. Output: bpmn_diagram.bpmn

generator_tools.name: generate_pytorch
generator_tools.description: Generate PyTorch neural-network training/eval code from the NN model. REQUIRES a neural-network model (and PyTorch installed). Output: pytorch_nn.py

generator_tools.name: generate_tensorflow
generator_tools.description: Generate TensorFlow/Keras neural-network training/eval code from the NN model. REQUIRES a neural-network model (and TensorFlow installed). Output: tf_nn.py
